title: Pangu Splits Heaven and Earth

source.chapter: compiled by Xu Zheng, Three Kingdoms · Wu
source.quote: Heaven and earth were in chaos like a hen's egg, and Pangu was born inside it. After eighteen thousand years heaven and earth opened: the clear rose to become sky, the murky sank to become earth.

moral: He turned himself into the whole world.

story.title: No Sky, No Earth
story.text: Long, long ago, sky and earth were not yet apart.
story.narration: Long, long ago, sky and earth had not yet separated.

story.title: A Great Egg
story.text: The universe was like an egg, and Pangu slept inside.
story.narration: The universe was like a great egg, and Pangu slept inside it.

keyMoment.question: Pangu lay down. So where did the world come from?

options.text: His body became the sky, the earth and everything

keyMoment.reveal: Pangu lay down, but his eyes became the sun and moon and his blood became the rivers — the world is what he left behind.

misconceptions: When Pangu lay down, everything was gone
The sky and earth were always there

quiz.question: What did Pangu's left and right eyes become?
quiz.explanation: His left eye became the sun, his right eye the moon.

quiz.question: How long did Pangu hold the sky and the earth apart?
quiz.explanation: The sky rose a zhang a day and the earth thickened a zhang a day, for eighteen thousand years.

quiz.question: Which of these is also 'becoming something else'?
options: A seed lies in the soil
quiz.explanation: In both, one thing turns into another.

orbs.speak: His left eye became the sun
His right eye became the moon
His breath became the wind and clouds
His skin and hair became the plants
